scheme_name: Indirect Tax Internship Scheme In Central Board Of Indirect Taxes And Customs (CBIC)
other_conditions: Law students pursuing a 3‑year LLB or 5‑year integrated LLB course
Law graduates who have completed a 3‑year LLB or 5‑year integrated LLB course and are within two years of graduation
Applicants must have appeared in the final year/semester examination on the cutoff date
Preference is given to students/graduates of reputed institutions
Interns must attend full‑time physically and cannot pursue any other course or work during the internship
benefits_summary: Students receive a stipend of ₹5,000 per month and graduates ₹15,000 per month; a Certificate of Internship is awarded upon successful completion.
documents_required: Filled and self‑attested application form (prescribed format)
